intent: Final independent pre-execution audit of the corrected participation-only diagnostic and immutable r2 preparation.

previous_audit.status: Prior changes-required verdict retained for its inspected source; original prepared run remains unrun.

probes.method: Read the exact inspected source, evaluate its load, snapshot, report and classification validation blocks in an isolated in-memory context with synthetic records and no filesystem writes or provider calls. Positive controls ensure rejection is caused by the intended identity checks.

resolved_findings.resolution: Policy now requires clear deliberate refusal, while retaining tutoring for genuine attempts, mistakes, clarification, frustration, reasoned disagreement and ordinary topic preferences.
Existing report fingerprint/results and full classifier object must match freshly derived values, otherwise resume fails.
Saved input, source type, role, partitions and target generation are checked against the frozen case and selected final call.

Target, parsed outputs and exact deterministic results are derived from recorded calls. A second call is rejected after a valid first answer or transport error, and requires the configured format-repair allowance.
Every frozen identity field is compared with the reconstructed identity in addition to the fingerprint. Changed saved labels with an unchanged fingerprint are rejected.

preparation_integrity: Recomputed r2 fingerprint from all frozen identity fields; it matches the declared fingerprint.
Frozen source and policy bytes match current files; all3 dependency bodies match disk.
Complete baseline report hash matches the audited183-record v1.3-r2 report.
Original cases, settings, manifest and authority-source snapshots equal the complete baseline. Derived cases change only check scope to mode_selection and remove legacy checks.
All61 request contexts preserve scenario, conversation history, current contribution, known prior mode and inventory; evaluator labels and case metadata are not target inputs.
Prepared r2 contains no generation records at audit; all183 planned repetitions remain required.
interpretation: The task decomposition, system prompt/context composition and reduced output schema are declared bundled diagnostic factors. G01 eligibility remains intact. A result measures isolated participation classification under this condition, not a complete tutor or an automatic runtime mode override.
remaining_requirements: Preserve every one of the183 outputs and all format/transport attempts; maintain failures and errors in coverage.
Use existing classification aggregation, partitions and baseline predictions without threshold or label changes.
If advanced, separately audit the full response stage and its interaction with the participation decision, then perform complete behavior evaluation and product verification.
Reason's40-word policy guidance is not enforced by the stage parser; semantic reason quality and full response realization remain unmeasured by this diagnostic.
